questions.stem: A researcher is examining the relationship between socioeconomic status and IQ scores. Initially, the researcher obtains a random sampling of 300 high school students from public schools nationwide and conducts IQ tests on all participants. Recently, the researcher received additional funding to enable an increase in sample size to 2,000 participants. Assuming that all other study conditions are held constant, which of the following is most likely to occur as a result of this additional funding?

options.label: A
options.text: Increase in range of the confidence interval

options.label: C
options.text: Decrease in standard error of the mean

options.label: D
options.text: Increase in probability of type II error
